INTERNAL · HUMAN REVIEW

Support review

A short suggestion to help you review a ticket. Your help desk stays unchanged.

Sign in
Sign out & clear

Sign in to get a suggestion.

Synthetic or redacted ticket

Up to 20 KB of UTF-8 text. No attachments. Text is processed in Sydney and is not saved by this tool. Suggestions can contain mistakes.

Get suggestion
Clear suggestion
Clear all text
Clear all text when finished. Successful processing clears the pasted ticket; the suggestion remains until you clear it or leave this page. On failure the ticket stays on this page so you can retry. Reloading clears ticket text and requires sign-in.
